original_test_intent: Verify the version fields presented by BMC GPU Management against the approved platform specification, with OS/NVIDIA evidence correlated to every installed GPU.
original_method: Identify the SUT/BMC and every GPU by stable PCIe/device identity, capture the BMC Web Versions page, collect complete per-device nvidia-smi driver/VBIOS data and NVSM version, normalize only owner-approved formats, map each displayed field to its authoritative component and compare it with the expected version matrix without changing any stack component.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the expected component/version matrix and field mapping; an operator verifies the BMC page and target identity while automation captures and correlates protected read-only outputs.
required_inputs: BMC Web Versions labels and documented API if any
Expected GPU model, driver, VBIOS/firmware and NVSM matrix
Supported NVIDIA driver/nvidia-smi and NVSM packages
Protected OS/BMC access and redaction policy
safety_requirements: Do not install, upgrade, downgrade or reload driver, VBIOS, NVSM or BMC firmware
Do not expose passwords, tokens, serials or sensitive endpoint data
Do not assume GPU enumeration order is stable
Retain full outputs rather than selected matching lines
Stop interpretation on missing device, identity mismatch or ambiguous field
Preserve GPU/kernel/SEL history and do not clear logs
agent_execution_scope: Verify SUT/BMC and GPU identity map
Capture the BMC Versions view or approved read-only API
Collect full nvidia-smi and NVSM version outputs
Correlate fields and compare with the supplied matrix
Record mismatches and logs without changing software or firmware
engineer_actions: Supply and approve the version matrix
Define BMC label-to-component mapping and normalization
Resolve missing or conflicting version sources

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: nvidia-smi and NVSM corroborate host-side driver/VBIOS/tool versions, but they omit the required BMC Web view and use unsafe sshpass/host-validation bypass; they also lack stable per-GPU correlation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture the BMC GPU Versions view and protected complete `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,uuid,pci.bus_id,name,driver_version,vbios_version --format=csv` plus supported NVSM version output, then compare mapped fields to the owner matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC Web Versions, SPEC comparison and 10/10-minute estimates remain; OS tools are supporting evidence, not a replacement path.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a per-component table keyed by stable GPU identity that shows BMC label/value, OS/NVIDIA source/value, normalization rule, expected value and comparison result, retaining raw captures and timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative identity and corroboration to the source's BMC page without introducing any update action.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS tools alone cannot prove the BMC page displays the correct data; the BMC view alone cannot establish which physical GPU or driver/VBIOS source it represents.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC inventory can lag host state, mixed VBIOS fleets may be legitimate only when explicitly specified, and driver version may repeat across devices without being device-specific.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define authoritative expected values and whether a documented BMC API is equivalent to the Web page. A missing NVSM installation may reduce corroboration but cannot silently remove required BMC coverage.
expected_evidence: Verified SUT/BMC and complete GPU UUID/PCIe/slot identity map
Owner-approved expected driver/VBIOS/GPU/NVSM matrix and normalization rules
Timestamped BMC Web/API Versions capture with every displayed label/value
Protected complete nvidia-smi and NVSM outputs with exit status
Relevant GPU/kernel/SEL evidence, no-mutation/security audit and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires BMC GPU version data compared with the specification. DeepSeek's OS-only method is incomplete but not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The expected version matrix, supported packages and BMC access are normal project inputs; the target information and read-only purpose are clear.

review_improvement: Restores the literal BMC Web coverage and prevents device-order or version-scope errors by separating driver, VBIOS and NVSM authority for every stable GPU identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Version correctness is a relationship between a named component and an expected release, not simply the presence of a plausible string. Since BMC display rows, GPU enumeration and host-wide driver data have different scopes, acceptance requires a stable device map and explicit label authority. Otherwise a valid version from one GPU or layer can falsely satisfy another.
